exceptions.rationale: Checkov 3.4.5 hard-pins asteval==1.0.6. The latest Checkov release tested on 2026-11-17 still has that pin, so overriding it would violate Checkov's declared dependency contract and could change scanner behavior.
exceptions.mitigation: asteval is used only through the isolated Checkov scanner dependency tree; tf-eu-guard does not import it. Keep Checkov and the runtime lock hash-pinned, run pip-audit on every CI build, and reassess this exception at the review date or when Checkov publishes a compatible release.
exceptions.reachability: Reachable. Checkov renders Terraform variables and expressions from the scanned code through asteval (checkov/terraform/graph_builder/variable_rendering/safe_eval_functions.py), so attacker-controlled Terraform in a pull request is evaluated by the vulnerable library even though tf-eu-guard never imports it. Mitigation: the Action runs the scanner with --network none, --read-only plus a tmpfs, --cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges and a read-only workspace mount (only a separate output directory is writable), and Checkov runs with --skip-download.

exceptions.rationale: This GHSA is the same locked asteval 1.0.6 exposure reported by pip-audit. Checkov 3.4.5 is the newest available Checkov release tested on 2026-11-17 and requires asteval==1.0.6; an uncoordinated override is not reproducible or dependency-consistent.
exceptions.mitigation: Run the scanner in the pinned Docker/runtime environment, do not use asteval as an application API, and keep the strict pip-audit check active with this exception explicitly named. Re-test Checkov before the review date.

exceptions.rationale: ecdsa==0.19.2 is a Checkov transitive dependency and is already the latest PyPI release tested on 2026-11-17. pip-audit reports no upstream fix version, and Checkov 3.4.5 does not offer a newer compatible dependency constraint.
exceptions.mitigation: tf-eu-guard does not import ecdsa directly. Keep it confined to the hash-locked Checkov environment, do not use it for application signing, run pip-audit on every CI build, and reassess when the advisory or Checkov dependency constraint changes.
exceptions.reachability: Not assessed as reachable from scanned code: tf-eu-guard does not import ecdsa and no path from scanned Terraform or Kubernetes content to it has been identified (not exhaustively verified). If one exists, the Action's container sandboxing (no network, read-only filesystems, dropped capabilities, read-only workspace) limits the impact.
